purpose: Select deterministic representative Skin fixtures from the Stage 3-1 inventory and require evidence that static artwork, Spine prefab dependencies, and model skin resources resolve to concrete authoritative assets before bulk extraction.

selectionPolicy.simpleSingleResource: among skins with exactly one distinct modelResourceId, choose the minimum model binding count
selectionPolicy.maxDistinctResources: choose first skin attaining the global maximum distinct modelResourceId count
selectionPolicy.maxTotalBindings: choose first skin attaining the global maximum model binding count
selectionPolicy.maxBindingsPerResource: choose first skin attaining the global maximum repeated binding count for one skinResourceId

static: fixture sourceImagePath exactly matches Stage 3-1 inventory
sourceImagePath resolves to a concrete authoritative source asset
evidence records the resolved source path and nonzero byte size
spine: fixture sourceSpinePath exactly matches Stage 3-1 inventory
sourceSpinePath resolves to a concrete authoritative prefab asset
actual dependency set is recorded from evidence rather than assumed
at least one concrete dependency record with path and type is present
model: every fixture modelResourceId is preserved from Stage 3-1 inventory
every fixture modelResourceId resolves to an authoritative concrete model resource or locator
numeric coincidence or filename similarity alone is not sufficient proof

statusPolicy.PASS: all representative fixture static, Spine, and model resolution evidence is present and validates
statusPolicy.READY_FOR_ASSET_EVIDENCE: fixture/gate construction validates but authoritative asset bytes or equivalent resolution evidence is unavailable
statusPolicy.FAIL: fixture selection, Stage 3-1 parity, or supplied evidence is inconsistent

prohibitedInference: asset existence or extraction success may not define release status
asset filename/path may not redefine owner or sourceOrder
Spine dependency layout may not be assumed without evidence
numeric overlap may not establish model-resource semantics
localExtractPath/exportPath/webPath assignment is outside Stage 3-2 readiness proof
nextActionOnPass: Skin Stage 3-3 static artwork extraction/export using the proven resolver rule.
nextActionWhenReady: Provide or mount the authoritative Unity asset source/root, generate Stage 3-2 evidence for the selected fixtures, and rerun the Stage 3-2 validator without recomputing Stage 3-1.
